introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure email security gateway for a university that protects students, faculty, staff, and administrators from phishing, malicious attachments, spoofed messages, and suspicious links.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: The system should inspect incoming and outgoing email traffic, detect suspicious messages, quarantine potentially harmful emails, generate security alerts, and allow authorized administrators to review and release quarantined messages.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: The platform should maintain audit logs of filtering decisions and administrator actions, integrate with the university identity system, and provide a dashboard for monitoring email security events.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The solution should be secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable for university-wide deployment.

functional.applicability_reason: Independent source obligations; unspecified choices remain TBD.

requirements.title: protect students, faculty, staff, and administrators from phishing, malicious attachments, spoofed messages, and suspicious links
requirements.statement: The system shall protect students, faculty, staff, and administrators from phishing, malicious attachments, spoofed messages, and suspicious links.

acceptance_criteria.given: system designs a secure email security gateway
acceptance_criteria.when: the system initiates protection against phishing, malicious attachments, spoofed messages, and suspicious links
acceptance_criteria.then: The system initiates protection against phishing, malicious attachments, spoofed messages, and suspicious links, and external test capture confirms the resulting response.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: inspect incoming and outgoing email traffic
requirements.statement: The system shall inspect incoming and outgoing email traffic.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system inspects incoming and outgoing email traffic
acceptance_criteria.when: incoming and outgoing email traffic is processed
acceptance_criteria.then: the system returns a verified inspection record of all messages
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: detect suspicious messages
requirements.statement: The system shall detect suspicious messages.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system detects suspicious messages in email traffic
acceptance_criteria.when: a message exhibits known malicious patterns or behaviors
acceptance_criteria.then: the system identifies and flags the message as suspicious
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define suspicious email content?

requirements.title: quarantine potentially harmful emails
requirements.statement: The system shall quarantine potentially harmful emails.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system quarantines potentially harmful emails
acceptance_criteria.when: a message is identified as potentially harmful
acceptance_criteria.then: the email is held in quarantine with no specified storage mechanism
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: generate security alerts
requirements.statement: The system shall generate security alerts.

acceptance_criteria.when: a suspicious or harmful message is detected
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow authorized administrators to review quarantined messages
requirements.statement: The system shall allow authorized administrators to review quarantined messages.

acceptance_criteria.when: a message is in quarantine and accessible via admin interface
acceptance_criteria.then: administrators view the content and metadata of the quarantined message
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the inspection record

requirements.title: allow authorized administrators to release quarantined messages
requirements.statement: The system shall allow authorized administrators to release quarantined messages.

acceptance_criteria.when: an administrator confirms a quarantined message is safe
acceptance_criteria.then: the quarantined message is released to the recipient after administrator confirmation
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: maintain audit logs of filtering decisions and administrator actions
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain audit logs of filtering decisions and administrator actions.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system maintains audit logs of filtering decisions and administrator actions
acceptance_criteria.when: an administrator performs a filtering decision or admin action
acceptance_criteria.then: The audit logs are observed to exist and contain entries for each filtering decision and administrator action performed.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

unresolved_decisions: Which fields must the audit logs contain?
What retention period is required for the audit logs?

requirements.title: integrate with the university identity system
requirements.statement: The system shall integrate with the university identity system.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system integrates with the university identity system
acceptance_criteria.when: an identity system user attempts to access email services
acceptance_criteria.then: the system authenticates the user using credentials from the university identity system
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: provide a dashboard for monitoring email security events
requirements.statement: The system shall provide a dashboard for monitoring email security events.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system provides a dashboard for monitoring email security events
acceptance_criteria.when: an administrator accesses the dashboard interface
acceptance_criteria.then: The dashboard interface is observed to exist and display email security event data upon access.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the inspection record
